PEDIATRIC ARCH SUPPORT
Final Design Review | Group 11



Prepared By: Thomas Barnett, Levi Willgruber, Hamza Al Halabi

Department: Biomedical Engineering

Date: 8 August 2026

PROBLEM STATEMENT


OBJECTIVE
To design a positionally adaptable orthopedic device for growing
children (ages 5-7) with symptomatic pediatric pes planus (flat
foot).

CLINICAL NEED
   • Alleviate medial longitudinal arch discomfort.
   • Accommodate rapid volumetric foot growth.
   • Provide a low-cost, non-invasive alternative to rigid orthotics.

CLINICAL BACKGROUND & APPROACH



ANATOMY OF PES PLANUS                                                  SYMPTOM TRACKING
Characterized by the collapse of the Medial Longitudinal Arch           • Excessive pronation during gait cycle.
(MLA). In children aged 5-7, the foot is in a critical developmental    • Plantar fasciitis risk in early childhood.
phase.                                                                  • Muscle fatigue in the Tibialis Posterior.

VALMASSY FORMULA
The Resting Calcaneal Stance Position (RCSP) typically corrects by
approximately 1° per year until age 7.

COMPETITIVE BENCHMARKING




Criteria         Rigid Orthotics        OTC Insoles   Group 11 Solution


Adaptability     None (Fixed)           Minimal       High (Sleeve)

Comfort          Low (Rigid Plastic)    Moderate      High (Gel/Fabric)

Cost             $200+ (Custom)         $15 - $30     $18-$24

Growth Scaling   Requires Replacement   Disposable    Modular Inserts

USER NEEDS & DESIGN INPUTS




User Need                           Design Input (Requirement)                    Verification Method


Withstands impacts in daily play.   Must withstand an impact force of 3600 lbs.   Impact Testing

Scales with foot size.              Sleeve elasticity allow 10% volume growth.    Tensile Testing

Alleviate Arch Pain.                Support 150N ground reaction force (GRF).     FMEA / Load Testing

Low profile in shoes.               Total thickness < 8mm in midfoot area.        Caliper Measure

FINAL DESIGN DETAILS

ASSEMBLY OVERVIEW
 • Sleeve: Breathable Muslin.
 • Strap: Elastic Band
 • Pocket: Reinforced internal stitching.
 • Insert: Gel-Adhesive Combination.

RISK ANALYSIS (FMEA)




Failure Mode               Effect                            Severity   Mitigation


Pad Slippage               Loss of arch support              Medium     Non-slip pocket lining

Material Tearing           Device failure                    High       Industrial Sewing

Circulatory Constriction   Pain / Numbness                   Extreme    Limited compression gradient

Hygiene (Sweat)            Skin irritation                   Low        Antimicrobial mesh choice

Pad Burst                  Loss of support, Device Failure   High       Reinforcing gel casing

NEXT STEPS & LEARNINGS
